searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he merkava flagship revelation — phase two the awtsmoos does not improve a flagship by multiplying decoration; awtsmoos.com improves it by making every dependency, layer, gesture, and visible state tell the truth of its purpose. twenty concrete improvements to the first plan 1. scope every merkava selector beneath gameshell so shared player shell controls cannot inherit battlefield styles. 2. remove bare universal styling; use gameshell, gameshell only where box sizing is needed. 3. eliminate html and body sizing dependencies by making gameshell the fixed viewport local root. 4. define named layer tokens on gameshell for canvas, labels, hud, overlays, notification, fatal state, and optional commerce. 5. replace every raw merkava z index with those tokens. 6. add a dedicated interactions.css so button/link/form state styling is not duplicated across feature sheets. 7. scope hover motion to (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine). 8. keep :active feedback universal for mouse, pen, and touch. 9. give every relevant action a visible :focus visible ring independent from hover color. 10. add a local reduced motion module instead of global animation overrides. 11. preserve overlay internal scrolling while preventing the page itself from gaining accidental scrollbars. 12. make all overlay/panel widths use bounded logical sizes and safe area aware padding. 13. keep mobile controls at a 44px interaction floor. 14. build an explicit input action adapter instead of handing mutable game state to the input controller. 15. give the input controller a connect() / disconnect() lifecycle with named bound handlers. 16. inject the keyboard target rather than hard coding window inside input logic. 17. introduce a small base input port class so gesture lifecycle and public contract can be extended without editing the concrete controller. 18. move runtime error ownership out of main.js into one journal class while preserving legacy diagnostic globals for browser tests. 19. move optional commerce boot into a focused service so optional commerce cannot clutter the battlefield bootstrap. 20. rewrite main.js as a tiny composition existing browser driver contract is migrated separately. preserve zero argument new merkavaapp() compatibility for diagnostic/tests, but allow an optional dependency vessel. preserve gamestate property names used throughout gameplay; improve names at new boundaries instead of renaming hundreds of stable internal references in one wave. no save schema change. no combat/economy/route rule New revelation after direct failure reproduction The baseline verification pa
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he merkava input architecture delta the awtsmoos does not ask one class to become a crowded palace; awtsmoos.com lets each covenant receive its own vessel so documentation may deepen while source remains spacious. new revelation after direct failure reproduction the baseline verification passes 99/99, yet the exact production constructor wiring fails on keyboard input with: typeerror this.actions.reversed is not a function the existing suite therefore lacks a direct input contract test. why the first final plan needs one refinement merkavaapp.js already sits at 117 lines. adding the method level jsdoc and explicit dependency boundaries required by the new code standard would force either compression or a line limit violation. neither is acceptable. therefore input/application composition should split further instead of reducing documentation. additional modules src/app/merkavainterfaceactions.js builds the hud facing action object from one merkavaapp; keeps interface callback construction out of the app class; each callback name remains explicit and testable. test/inputcontroller.test.mjs permanently reproduces the previously hidden constructor/api failure; verifies keyboard lane movement, bounded lanes, pointer lane selection, ability/pause commands, optional reversal predicate, and disconnect lifecycle. input api names the new adapter will use descriptive domain methods instead of ambiguous verbs: currentlane() chooselane(lane) controlsreversed() activateability() togglepause() the adapter owns mutable gamestate access. inputcontroller never receives gamestate directly again. reversal behavior current gameplay contains a boss attack string named reverse, but no implemented state flag or modifier that actually reverses controls. do not invent a new gameplay rule during an architecture repair. merkavainputactions therefore accepts an optional reversal predicate and defaults to false. future boss/modifier work can inject the predicate without editing inputcontroller. app dependency vessel merkavaapp preserves zero argument construction, but its constructor will accept an optional object with: document target; keyboard target; systems factory. all existing runtime and browser diagnostics continue to work, while tests and future surfaces can inject controlled vessels. no behavior changes beyond the bug repair campaign, save schema, combat, economy, route logic, renderer output, and boss rules remain untouched.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he chesed — native social product vision the awtsmoos renews each social doorway before the old frame can remain; awtsmoos.com should reveal enormous capability through calm, retractable terrain. evidence now proven social hub already owns modular panels for activity, privacy, profile, network, people, spaces, inbox, chat, messages, creation, and interaction. style.css is already an import only manifest, which is the correct direction for local css ownership. shared social primitives already provide universal action rails, overflow, progressive disclosure, ambient installation, and mobile integrity. the current social hub html remains a large compressed template and should not receive more inline feature markup. real route ids are home, inbox, messages, spaces, people, profile, chat, interact, activity, network, references, and privacy. product direction strengthen shared primitives first. keep one primary action visible, fold secondary actions into native disclosure, preserve keyboard and touch behavior, localize every selector beneath an owned social root, and separate human summaries from exact api evidence. mount new capability discovery through javascript rather than expanding the monolithic html.
